comments.text: For those who don't know, section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 is a law that bans discrimination against people with disabilities in any program or activity that recieves federal funding. It's one of the laws that provides accomodations for kids with disabilties in school and more.

comments.text:
Thank you for talking about this!! I had a 504 plan as a kid after I was diagnosed with t1 diabetes. It was a struggle to make it through school because I was sick so often, but it would've been nearly impossible without it. 
My 504 plan allowed me to eat in class for low blood sugar, make up missed work, have water in class for high blood sugar, AND ENSURED MY TEACHERS KNEW HOW TO TREAT LOWS WHICH ARE IMMEDIATELY DANGEROUS!!! Taking this away should be more than enough to prove they don't care about people, especially disabled people and kids.
